（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. I. D. REGISTRY No. 10 D 8/4 D）

March 6, 9

President
Provisional Court.

Sir,

I have to acknowledge receipt of your letter of
February-1929 regarding an article entitled "Hyang Kuo
Tshung Tshiou" (香國春秋), appearing in the newspaper
"Hai Pao" (海報), and in reply to inform you that both
the article and the paper in question have been carefully
scrutinized, but as there is nothing indecent in either,
it would appear that there are no grounds for prosecution.

lca
A/ Director of Criminal Investigation.

三月六日，九时

临时法院院长。

先生：

谨此确认收到阁下关于一九二九年二月刊登于《海报》（Hai Pao）报纸上题为“香国春秋”（Hyang Kuo Tshung Tshiou）之文章的来函，并回复告知，经仔细审查该文章及涉事报纸，鉴于二者均无淫秽内容，似无起诉依据。

lca
代理刑事侦缉处处长。

究均無隱穢可言因之無從起訴相應函復即

REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. L. O. D. 78
I.C. Chinese Section Station,
Date....................
Date March 6, 1929.

Subject (in full) Chinese Newspaper "Hai Pao".

Made by S.D.I. Police. Forwarded by. J.W. Swens Ab. (BC)

In reference to the above mentioned inquiries that the newspaper
"Hai Pao" (海报) has been in existence for the past four
years, with offices at No. 370 Hung Shin Li (鸿兴里), Peking
Road, under the manager Ho Jin San (何钦珊), who also
carries on business as a Chinese style doctor, residing on the
premises. The editor, one Van Tien Ling (范天民) resides
in the Chinese City. The paper is printed by the Ming Sing
Printing Co., Nanking Road. Several copies, different issues,
of the paper were obtained, and translations of the serial
story by one Kuo Tshung Tshieu (香国春秋) in the paper show
nothing of an indecent nature or even suggestive of lewdness.
I have submitted the copies of the newspaper and translation
of the story, to Mr. Ham, asst. P.P.I. and he is of the
opinion that there is nothing, in the paper or story, indecent,
therefore no grounds for prosecution.

(批：Red Letter (short)
Saymon
6/3. A.J.P. (Pol.))

J.W. Prince
C. D. I.

a/L.B.I.
Information. In view of the above
report, it seems time that no further action
will be necessary.
J.K.
6/3/29.

事由（全称）：中文报纸《海报》。

由特别侦探警员制作。转呈人：J.W. Swens Ab. (BC)

就上述查询事宜，《海报》（Hai Pao）已存在四年，办事处位于北京路鸿兴里（Hung Shin Li）370号，经理为何钦珊（Ho Jin San），其亦以中医为业，并居住于该址。编辑范天民（Van Tien Ling）一人，居住于华界。该报由南京路明兴印刷公司（Ming Sing Printing Co.）承印。获取了该报不同期数的数份样本，对报上连载小说《香国春秋》（Kuo Tshung Tshieu）的译文显示，其中并无任何淫秽性质，甚至无任何暗示猥亵的内容。我已将报纸样本及故事译文提交给助理警务督察长 Ham 先生，他认为该报或故事中并无淫秽内容，因此无起诉依据。

（批注：红函（简略）
Saymon

pages.en:
Translation of a paragraph from a novel
entitled "Shang Koh Chun Tsieu" published by the
"Hai Pao", a three-day periodical, dated February
3, 1929.

A Buddhist priest named Jeu Shou Kang
is a native of Kwangsi. He was at one time sentenced
to life imprisonment by the Manchu Government for
being connected with Tsieu King, a Shaoshing female
rebel, who was executed by the Manchu Government.
He was liberated on the abdication of the Manchu
Court. In commemoration of his deceased wife, he
went to the Wu Tan Shan (Hill) where he became a
Buddhist priest.
Being his intimate friend, President Pang
persuaded the Buddhist priest to resume private life
again but he declined to do so. President Pang then
appointed him abbot of the Pau Pen Tz (temple) in
Peking and directed his legal wife to become a
follower of the abbot.
As the President's wife had also become
one of his followers, the name of this Buddhist priest
has become famous throughout the country. However
he does not interfere with other people's affairs.
Apart from eating meat, he does not commit any other
unlawful acts. In consequence of this, most of the
high dignitaries are on friendly terms with him.
To-day he was invited by Ping Pu Ching
to play dominoes at the house of a sing song girl
named Siao Hwo Kwei. On his arrival, he overheard
his friends inside the room talking about him..
He stopped for a while and listened and upon not
hearing them using bad words against him, he stepped
inside the house and laughingly said:-
"I came here when you were talking about
me. A Buddhist priest should never eat meat but I
eat meat and drink wine. Although I am face to face
with sing song girls, they create no impression upon
me. Gentlemen, do you believe me?"
All the persons present unanimously replied:-
"If we have no confidence in you, we would not have
cared to associate with you."
pages.zh:
译自三日刊《海报》于一九二九年二月三日刊载的小说《香国春秋》（Shang Koh Chun Tsieu）中的一段文字。

一位名为 Jeu Shou Kang 的和尚是广西人。他曾因与绍兴女革命党人秋瑾（Tsieu King）有牵连，被满清政府判处终身监禁，秋瑾后被满清政府处决。他在满清朝廷退位后获释。为纪念亡妻，他前往五台山（Wu Tan Shan），在那里出家为僧。

由于是他的密友，徐总统（President Pang）劝说他重新过世俗生活，但他拒绝了。随后，徐总统任命他为北京宝盆寺（Pau Pen Tz）的住持，并指令其发妻成为该住持的信徒。

由于总统夫人也成为了他的信徒之一，这位和尚的名声传遍全国。然而，他并不干涉他人的事务。除了吃肉之外，他没有任何其他违法行为。因此，大多数高官显贵都与他交好。

今日，他应平步青（Ping Pu Ching）之邀，前往一名名叫小胡桂（Siao Hwo Kwei）的妓女家中玩牌九。到达时，他无意中听到房间内的朋友正在谈论他。他驻足片刻倾听，在并未听到他们使用针对他的恶语后，他走进屋内，笑着说道：
“你们在谈论我时我来了。和尚本不该吃肉，但我吃肉喝酒。虽然我面对妓女，但她们对我毫无影响。诸位先生，你们相信我吗？”
在场众人一致回答：“如果我们不信任你，就不会愿意与你交往了。”

Translation.

Shanghai Provisional Court,
Shanghai, February 1929.

Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council.

Sir,

I have received a letter from the Educational Bureau of
the Special Municipality stating as follows:-

"It is found that there are several
tens of kinds of small newspapers
that are circulated in the Interna-
tional Settlement and that amongst
them there are many whose principles
are sound and proper. However, there
are also many whose writings are de-
famatory and alienable to lewdness.

For instance, a lengthy novel entitled
"Hyang-Kuo-Tshung-Tshieu" published
in the "Hai-Pao" newspaper is one of
the above category. Its indecent asser-
tions are revealed frequently in the
wordings. Your Honourable Court is re-
quested to communicate with the Shang-
hai Municipal Council for its prohibi-
tion so as to avoid circulation. The
address of "Hai-Pao" is No.873 Oeng-
Shing-Lee, Peking Road, and the name
of the Manager and Editor is Ho Yah
Tsiau."
pages.zh:
译文。

上海临时法院，
上海，1929年2月。

警察总监，
上海公共租界工部局。

先生：

本人收到特别市教育局来函，内容如下：

“经查，有数十种小报在公共租界内流传，其中许多报刊宗旨端正得体。然而，也有许多报刊文字诽谤且易流于淫秽。

例如，《海报》（Hai-Pao）报纸上刊登的长篇连载小说《香国春秋》（Hyang-Kuo-Tshung-Tshieu）即属此类。其淫秽言论在字里行间频繁显露。恳请贵院与上海公共租界工部局联系，予以查禁，以防流传。《海报》地址为北京路翁兴里（Oeng-Shing-Lee）873号，经理兼编辑姓名为 Ho Yah Tsiau。”

Ho Shih-Chen,

pages.en:
送行者本無行別市政府教育局因向在公共租界發行之小報不下數十
種其中宗旨純正者固居多數而個寫穢褻跡涉誨淫者亦屬不少如海報所
登之長篇小說香閨春秘即其一例其申淫穢語氣既時流露於字裏行間
則買読簡知工部局功實取以免得佛寺因准此仰即
處長查切載明實取主經公議此致
